files.purpose: The per-thread live engine of Droppy Code: a @MainActor @Observable class owning one chat thread's timeline entries, turn records, provider session lifecycle, streaming delta coalescing, approval and question queues, follow-up queue with bundling, git checkpointing and diff attribution, Hydra multi-head delegation, head reports and auto-merge, and the thread document persistence. It also defines TimelineEntry, ReplyQuote, DraftCommand, ComposerDraft, PromptEdit and RuntimePhase in the same file.

side_effects: Reads the thread document off the main thread at init: Task.detached(priority: .userInitiated) running Storage.decodeDocument(threadID) with a ThreadDocument(threadID:) fallback, unless DocumentPrefetch.shared.take(threadID) already holds it
Writes the thread file via DiskWriter.shared.encodeAndWrite(snapshotForPersistence(), to: Storage.threadURL(threadID)) inside saveNow()
Save timers: 800 ms debounce while idle; one shared 5 second timer while a turn runs; saveNow() cancels and clears saveTask and skips the write when saveRevision == lastSavedRevision
Launches provider processes and API sessions in ensureSession; stops them with session.stop() from releaseSession(stop:)
warmSession() starts a CLI process while the user types, skipped for isAPIKeyBased providers, archived threads, or when a session already exists

Runs git subprocesses through Git: isRepository, captureCheckpoint for the start and end checkpoint of each turn, captureTree, changedPaths, diff, restore, previewRestore, output with ["rev-parse", "--verify", base] and ["rev-parse", "--show-prefix"]
Restores working-tree files on revert with Git.restore(preview.restorable.map(\.path), from: base), a destructive operation

Timers and tasks: an 8 second interrupt watchdog that releases the session and finishes the turn as interrupted; a head budget task sleeping HydraBudget.reportSeconds or HydraBudget.maxSeconds plus 90 seconds for API-key providers; takeBackRunningTurn polls up to 200 times at 50 ms; holdSentDelegationBlock sleeps HydraPrompts.delegationSentHold then HydraPrompts.delegationLeaveFade; finishTurn races command settles against a 3 second sleep for non-completed turns
Spawns helper agent threads through app.spawnDroppyHead and app.spawnNativeHead, and triggers app.autoMergeHydraWork(of:) which commits, pushes and opens merge requests
Indirect model calls: TextGeneration.threadTitle(for:engine:) to name the thread, plus provider catalog and slash-command loading
LoginEnvironment.load() is awaited before a session is made so a CLI on the login-shell PATH is found
app.threadNeedsAttention(threadID) fires on approval and question events
Drives SwiftUI animation from the model with withAnimation(.easeOut(duration: 0.4)) and withAnimation(Chrome.panelSlide) around delegation-card mutations

feature_notes: Streaming flush pacing: flushWindow = .milliseconds(45); flushDelay(for:scrolling:) returns 45 for a pending length under 4096, 90 under 32768, and 150 beyond, and max(paced, 160) while ScrollActivity.shared.isScrolling, which the comment describes as at most six flushes a second

StreamLoad: headFlushBudget = 70 milliseconds, stale = .seconds(2), headFlushDelayMilliseconds = max(45, streamingCount * 70); a head's sleep is max(pacedDelay, headFlushDelay) and its immediate-flush window is headFlushWindow
appendStreamed avoids copying the whole message per flush by assigning self = .todos([]) to drop the enum's reference before appending and re-wrapping, keeping the append amortized O(delta)
editDiffLimit = 200_000 UTF-8 bytes: a FileEdit whose diff exceeds it keeps stats only (diff set to nil), applied both in capped(_:) and in fileEdits(from:repositoryRoot:)
maxDelegatedTasks = 32 tasks per delegation block; maxRefusedBlocks = 3 refusal turns per user request; delegation rounds are capped by HydraPrompts.maxDelegationRounds
The interrupt watchdog sleeps 8 seconds, then releases the session and finishes the turn as .interrupted

takeBackRunningTurn: Escape on a running turn stops it and rewinds with revert(to:restoreFiles: false), returning the message text and attachments to the composer; it polls for idle up to 200 times at 50 ms and gives up if the draft is no longer empty, heads are working, the message isFromHydra, or the turn left the thread; files stay as the turn left them

Head time budget: HydraBudget.maxSeconds plus 90 extra seconds when the head's provider isAPIKeyBased; a final report turn uses HydraBudget.reportSeconds; on expiry the head is interrupted and its next turn is HydraBudget.finalNote

apiTranscript(): keeps the last 40 messages via suffix(40) within a 60_000 character budget; a message that does not fit is truncated to an ellipsis plus its last budget characters when budget > 200, otherwise everything up to and including it is dropped; consecutive assistant fragments are joined with "\n\n" and tool calls are excluded

Diff caches: turnDiffs RecentCache(limit: 64) keyed by finished turn id, revisionDiffs RecentCache(limit: 4) keyed by the selection uuidString or the literal "all"; revertPreviews are valid for 10 seconds and only within the current diffRevision
append(_:) ends streaming on the last six entries (entries.suffix(6)) before adding a new one
Empty message and reasoning deltas never create a row, so redacted thinking leaves no blank entry; a completed message or reasoning whose text is all whitespace removes its row
Em-dash flattening: streamed message, reasoning and plan text pass through TextCleanup.withoutEmDashes, tool output does not because it is process text, and provider-supplied titles are flattened too

Session signature specifics: launchRuntimeMode only for cursor, grok, devin and antigravity (plus copilot when runtimeMode == .auto, mapped to .auto); launchEffort only for claude and antigravity; launchFast only for claude; launchModel and launchInteraction only for antigravity
serviceTier: only Codex sends one, taking the model's fastTier when thread.fastMode is set and the literal string "default" otherwise
lostConversation(_:) matches the case-insensitive substrings "no conversation found" and "no longer has this conversation"

Revert per provider: Codex rolls back from the first providerTurnID among the removed turns; Copilot rolls back turns: removed.count; Claude uses the previous turn's providerAnchor as providerResumeAt, or clears providerSessionID and providerResumeAt when index == 0; every other provider clears both and starts a new conversation
A session ID is held in unsentSessionID until the first message actually goes through it, so a warmed session replaced before sending never leaves an unresumable ID on the thread

Turn diff attribution counts only files this thread's tools reported or a command snapshot revealed; TouchedPaths.isBuildOutput filters build artifacts, with the comment citing 7,632 edits and 7 MB from build.noindex compiler-cache records, and attributedPaths keeps a path on the row that reported it first

Command edit detection takes no snapshot when the command starts because it would race the command; treeBeforeCommand() prefers settledTree with a matching treeEpoch, then latestTree, then the turn's baseCheckpoint; captureTree serializes snapshots one at a time per thread
finishTurn awaits every command settle when the status is .completed, otherwise races them against a 3 second sleep in a TaskGroup so Stop never hangs on git

Auto-merge runs only when the turn completed, nothing continues, hydraPendingReports, hydraBatches and hydraWaiting are all empty, hydra is on, settings.hydraAutoMerge is set, and runningHydraHeads(of:) == 0
Settings read here: hydraQueueHeads, hydraAlwaysHeads, hydraAutoMerge, hydraReviewHeads, antiSlopEnabled and apiKey(for:)
dispatchSentHead refuses to route the exact texts "/plan" and "/compact" to a head so local commands stay with the chat

The anti-slop policy and the forwarded continuation are each delivered once per session as a prompt prefix, only when SlashCommand.name(in: text) == nil, and are re-armed by releaseSession and by compact()
sessionEpoch gates event delivery so a dying session's late events are dropped, and releaseSession clears onEvent one runloop turn later via Task { old.onEvent = nil }

holdsOnlyPersistedState requires: phase == .idle, session == nil, not reverting, pendingSend == nil, not loading history, empty draft, no followUpEdit or messageEdit, no approvals or questions, empty hydraPendingReports, hydraBatches, hydraWaiting and hydraNativeHeads, no hydraFlushScheduled, hydraLanding == nil, not isHydraMerging, headBudget == nil, and empty commandTrees and commandSettles

The Rehearsal extension is shipped, not debug-only: rehearseTurn, rehearseBrief and rehearse feed events through the same handle(_:) path and are called from hydraAgentEvent and hydraAgentStarted to mirror a native head's transcript onto its own timeline; the doc comment also names website captures as a use
storeLegacyChanges backfills a FileChangeSummary onto an old turnEnd entry whose summary.changes is nil, so reopening a thread does not re-run git for historical cards
unresolved_questions: The numeric values of HydraBudget.maxSeconds, HydraBudget.reportSeconds, HydraPrompts.maxDelegationRounds, HydraPrompts.delegationSentHold and HydraPrompts.delegationLeaveFade are referenced but defined outside this bundle, so they could not be captured verbatim.
Chrome.panelSlide's curve and duration are defined elsewhere; only the call site is visible here.

The doc comment "True from init until a history that was not prefetched has been decoded and installed." sits directly above the followUps declaration with anomalous indentation on private(set) var followUps, so it appears to be a misplaced comment belonging to isLoadingHistory; whether that is deliberate cannot be determined from this file.
ChatThread.untitled's literal string and ProviderKind.displayName values are compared against and interpolated into user-visible text but are defined in other files.
RecentCache's eviction policy (LRU versus insertion order) is inferred from its name and its limit: argument; its implementation lives in another file.
HydraPrompts.streamedDelegations returns a value whose .delegations is used while the rest of the returned shape is not exercised here, so the full return type could not be determined from this file.
